vote.title: Maryland Gubernatorial General Election
vote.summary: Maryland's general election includes state, federal, and local offices. Election-day polling places are open from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

volunteer.title: Prince George's Parks volunteer
volunteer.summary: Help with a one-day or ongoing project in Prince George's County parks and recreation programs.

organizer.name: M-NCPPC Department of Parks and Recreation, Prince George's County

participation.whatYouWillDo: Support a park or recreation project selected through the official volunteer program.
participation.timeCommitment: Varies by project; confirm before signing up.
participation.riskClarity: Some roles may require an application or background check depending on duties and duration.

source.name: M-NCPPC Department of Parks and Recreation, Prince George's County

volunteer.title: Weed Warriors invasive-plant stewardship
volunteer.summary: Join supervised invasive-plant removal events in county parkland, or work toward volunteer certification for independent stewardship.
volunteer.timeCommitment: Event-based; certification requires training and supervised events

organizer.name: M-NCPPC Department of Parks and Recreation, Prince George's County

participation.whatYouWillDo: Learn to identify and remove invasive plants with tools and training provided at supervised events.
participation.timeCommitment: Public group events vary; Level 1 certification includes online courses, two events, and in-person training.
participation.riskClarity: Public events are for ages 16+; certification is for ages 18+ and work is outdoors.

source.name: M-NCPPC Department of Parks and Recreation, Prince George's County

volunteer.title: Elevate 360 County Service Corps
volunteer.summary: Assist county outreach events with setup, registration, logistics, and sharing public information.

organizer.name: Prince George's County Office of Community Relations

participation.whatYouWillDo: Support outreach and engagement events, including registration, logistics, and distribution of county information.
participation.timeCommitment: Varies by event; confirm availability with the program.
participation.riskClarity: Open to residents age 15+ who are comfortable interacting with residents and county staff.

source.name: Prince George's County Office of Community Relations
